description:

THE REST ARE NOT s494g's -- identical on dc20a721 -- and are left UNSPLICED here because "pre-existing" is WHEN, not WHY; each needs its cause attributed before it is spliced:

  uni/universal.t     86/4       88/2       88/2       88/2

Also: re/regexp_unicode_prop.t reads 778/332 on dc20a721 and on the tree but its ROWS pair differently each run -- t/re/regexp_unicode_prop.t:223 iterates `each %SHORT_PROPERTIES`, so it belongs with the *rows-unstable* registrations (#1082) like op/hash.t; the --all run reported it as NEW 20 / FIXED 258.  re/charset.t NEW 104 / FIXED 104 = the same rows re-SPELLED (`"\x85"` vs a raw byte in the description), identical on dc20a721.  op/write.t / op/lexsub.t single-row NEW/FIXED pairs: identical on dc20a721.

WHAT TO DO: bisect each numeric mover to its commit (the 40da28bd column shows most predate s494k/s495f; uni/method.t and re/pat_re_eval.t are s495f's), then splice row by row with the cause; register regexp_unicode_prop.t as rows-unstable.
